text:
Emma: quick check — staging logs are showing full request body for /v1/generate. I can see user emails and occasionally dev tokens. Is that allowed? cc @security-bot @Chris
security-bot: automated note — PII-in-logs is disallowed unless there's an approved retention exception. see /policies/pii-telemetry for details.
Chris: we intentionally log bodies in staging for prompt debugging. didn't realize emails were surfacing — we can flip a flag.
Olivia: prefer masking emails + tokens by default. simple regex replace for emails and redact bearer tokens before writing logs.
Alex: quick middleware patch idea (pseudo):
```
if ENV != 'local':
  body.prompt = scrub_emails(body.prompt)
  headers.pop('Authorization', None)
  body = redact_tokens(body)
```
Keep it opt-out for local dev.
Chris: ok I'll add a config `SCRUB_LLM_PAYLOADS=true` and canary to staging today.
Emma: pls add a unit test and a short note in the changelog about telemetry behavior.
Olivia: also emit a metric `llm_payloads_scrubbed` so we can monitor if someone disables the scrub.
security-bot: request recorded. if you plan to keep request bodies for more than 30 days or need raw access, open a SOC review / retention exception. ping me for expedited review.
Chris: will open a PR and link it here shortly.
Emma: thanks — also remember to strip prompt tokens in any saved traces or error reports.
(Deploy-bot): deploy queued: chris/scrub-llm-body -> staging (build 2026-06-14T09:12Z)
Chris: deployed to staging, logs now show masked values. sample entry: "\"prompt\": \"Hi, contact me at <EMAIL> and my api token is <REDACTED>\""
Olivia: looks good. please add a docs note under /docs/observability explaining default scrubbing and how to request exceptions.
Emma: filing a follow-up doc task and adding reviewers. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Chris: PR linked: https://git.internal/redwood/scrub-llm-body/pull/42 — asking for quick review from @Alex and @Olivia
Alex: reviewing now, will request minor nit re: test coverage.
Emma: closing loop here, we can promote to prod after SOC sign-off.
